settings.Description: Low stock when OnHand <= MinQty (LE) or OnHand < MinQty (LT). The workbook used both: the scanner warned at <= and the Low Stock list used <. Default LE as in the code pack.
settings.Title: LowStockRule

settings.Description: Client-side idle timeout of a badge session (minutes). Code-pack default 3; the original workbook used 15.
settings.Title: IdleTimeoutMinutes

settings.Description: Server-side backstop: a request is rejected if the session saw no accepted request for this long. Must be >= IdleTimeoutMinutes.
settings.Title: ServerSessionMaxIdleMinutes

settings.Description: If true the app ends the session after every successful submission.
settings.Title: LogoutAfterSubmit

settings.Description: Largest single RECEIPT (ADD) quantity. Enforced in the app AND by the processor.
settings.Title: MaxAddQty

settings.Description: Absolute audit variance at or above this asks for explicit confirmation.
settings.Title: AuditConfirmVariance

settings.Description: AUDIT requests need supervisor authority (authenticated Microsoft account).
settings.Title: RequireSupervisorForAudit

settings.Description: ITEM_CREATE / LOCATION_ADD need supervisor authority.
settings.Title: RequireSupervisorForNewItem

settings.Description: If false, ISSUE/RECEIPT are refused until the opening balance is Verified by a count.
settings.Title: AllowIssueAgainstUnverified

settings.Description: Display/scheduling zone (IANA). Storage is always UTC.
settings.Title: DisplayTimeZoneIana

settings.Description: Same zone as a Windows ID: Power Automate time-zone functions need this form.
settings.Title: DisplayTimeZoneWindows

settings.Description: A request in Processing longer than this may be taken over by the sweeper.
settings.Title: StaleClaimSeconds

settings.Description: A ledger Intent older than this is resolved by the sweeper (applied, completed or voided).
settings.Title: StaleIntentMinutes

settings.Description: After this many attempts a request with NO ledger intent is marked Failed/NotApplied.
settings.Title: MaxProcessAttempts

settings.Description: Requests waiting for a supervisor longer than this are Rejected (EXPIRED).
settings.Title: ApprovalExpiryHours

settings.Description: Terminal requests older than this are deleted weekly. Ledger rows are never deleted.
settings.Title: RequestRetentionDays

settings.Description: Ended/expired sessions older than this are deleted weekly.
settings.Title: SessionRetentionDays

settings.Description: Usage report windows in days.
settings.Title: UsageWindowsDays

settings.Description: Include legacy (workbook) issues in usage when their stock record is known.
settings.Title: UsageIncludeLegacy

settings.Description: Semicolon-separated. Flows refuse to send while this still contains CHANGE-ME.
settings.Title: ReportRecipientsLowStock

settings.Description: Weekly usage report recipients.
settings.Title: ReportRecipientsUsage

settings.Description: Weekly data-health and reconciliation recipients.
settings.Title: ReportRecipientsDataHealth

settings.Description: Failed / stuck request alerts.
settings.Title: ReportRecipientsOps

settings.Description: Local hour (0-23, display zone) at which the daily low-stock report is sent. Flow ticks hourly and checks this.
settings.Title: LowStockReportHourLocal

settings.Description: Local hour for the nightly balance-to-ledger reconciliation.
settings.Title: ReconcileHourLocal

settings.Description: Day for weekly data-health and usage reports.
settings.Title: WeeklyDayOfWeek

settings.Description: Local hour for weekly reports.
settings.Title: WeeklyHourLocal

settings.Description: Flow state (yyyy-MM-dd). Do not edit.
settings.Title: LastLowStockReportDate

settings.Description: Flow state (yyyy-MM-dd). Do not edit.
settings.Title: LastReconcileDate

settings.Description: Flow state (yyyy-MM-dd). Do not edit.
settings.Title: LastWeeklyHealthDate

settings.Description: Flow state (yyyy-MM-dd). Do not edit.
settings.Title: LastWeeklyUsageDate

settings.Description: App: milliseconds of no typing after which scanner text is treated as a complete scan (covers scanners with no/Enter/Tab suffix).
settings.Title: ScanCommitIdleMs

settings.Description: App: scans shorter than this are ignored as noise.
settings.Title: ScanMinLength

settings.Description: App: seconds between status polls while a request is unresolved.
settings.Title: StatusPollSeconds

settings.Description: App: after this long the screen says 'still processing' instead of waiting.
settings.Title: StatusPollTimeoutSeconds
